title: KRT Q3 2026 deep dive: margin pressures persist as new accounts and supply chain actions take center stage
summary: Foodservice packaging supplier Karat Packaging (NASDAQ:KRT) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 8.2% year on year to $134.7 million.
